name: Aozora Atori
source:
Occupation: Comic book artist

Subject: Art

Personality: A lady who likes cute girls. She is the third daughter of the Aozora Sisters, who is not interested in men. However, for some reason, she slowly becomes interested in the main character and asks him to be a model for her sketches.

[From [url=http://mbstruth.com/katei/cha/ato01.html]official site[/url]]
